Job Title: Trailer Chassis Frame Welder – Welder (First Class) ANZSCO 322313
Company: Sureweld Pty Ltd
Location: Wangaratta, VIC, Australia
Employment Type: Full-time
Recruitment managed by: Yakr Pty Ltd
Salary: $79,000 to $89,000 per annum, negotiable based on experience

Job Summary:
Our client, Sureweld, is seeking a talented and experienced Trailer Chassis Frame Welder to join our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Wangaratta, VIC. As a leading australian manufacturer of premium aluminium loading ramps and plant trailers, you will play a vital role in our production line.
You will expertly work with high-grade aluminium, ensuring all chassis frames are welded to the rigorous safety and quality standards that Sureweld is known for. With a focus on innovation and precision, you will collaborate with our engineering team to "keep Australians moving".

Key Responsibilities:
• Interpret technical drawings and computer models to determine specific welding requirements for aluminium trailer chassis.
• Work exclusively with high-quality aluminium alloys, utilizing specialized welding techniques (MIG/TIG) for lightweight, high- strength applications.
• Conduct material preparations, ensuring aluminium components are accurately cleaned and prepped for the production of trailer frames.
• Weld all Trailer Chassis Frames within the specified scope of design, ensuring compliance with Australian Design Rules (ADR).
• Liaise with Engineering & Drafting to provide feedback on drawings and assist in the continuous improvement of trailer designs.
• Collaborate with the Operations team to meet production scheduling targets and ensure all customer expectations for durability are met.
• Maintain a safe, clean, and uncluttered workspace, adhering to Sureweld’s strict safety protocols and industry-leading quality control.

Requirements:
• Completion of a trade certificate (e.g., Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade) or 3+ years of relevant experience in aluminium welding.
• Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy in structural welding.
• Ability to follow technical instructions and work with sophisticated manufacturing technology, including robotics where applicable.
• Commitment to safety and a strong work ethic, aligning with our family-owned company values.

Benefits:
• Competitive salary package within a growing, industry-leading company.
• Continuous training and development in a modern, purpose-built facility.
• Friendly and supportive team environment in regional Victoria.
• Exposure to the latest advancements in technology.

How to Apply:
If you’re ready to contribute to a team that values quality, integrity, and Australian ingenuity, please submit your resume/CV through our website.
Sureweld is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. We appreciate all applications, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted. (EM)

  Communication & Governance:   Experience producing high-quality, defensible reports while maintaining strict compliance with secure handling of sensitive data and data governance.

Summary: 
Join a world-leading School of Computer Science and Engineering and help shape the next generation of software engineers through innovative, high-quality teaching across contemporary Software Engineering disciplines.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in an Education Focused role. In this role, you will contribute to excellence in teaching and learning across Software Engineering, while helping to shape the next generation of software engineering professionals and computing graduates.

You will contribute to teaching across Software Engineering disciplines at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, delivering engaging learning experiences that prepare students for industry and research careers. You will play a key role in curriculum development, innovative teaching practice, and enhancing the student learning experience across the School.

With established strengths in software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and systems, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for educators who are passionate about teaching excellence, curriculum innovation, and student success. You will contribute to a collaborative academic community committed to advancing education and preparing students for real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative educational environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to educational excellence, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an engaging and passionate educator with expertise in Software Engineering and a commitment to delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences. You bring the ability to contribute to an inclusive and high-performing academic environment while supporting students across a range of Software Engineering disciplines.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will contribute to teaching, curriculum development, and student support across undergraduate and postgraduate courses, while continuing to develop your teaching practice and educational innovation capabilities.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate educational leadership through curriculum innovation, mentoring colleagues, leading teaching initiatives, and contributing to the advancement of teaching excellence across the School and broader UNSW Education Focused community.
You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to create meaningful learning experiences while building strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Actively stays up to date with discipline knowledge and professional development.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience in work-integrated learning (desirable).
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.

This is a role at WPP Media which is part of the WPP network.
Job Type: Full-time
Salary:$120,000-$140,000 inclusive of superannuation
Location: Office location will be determined dependent on the right applicant, as we have offices based in Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth and Brisbane

About WPP Media

WPP Media is the leading global media investment management company serving as the parent to WPP media agencies including Mindshare, EssenceMediacom, Wavemaker, Choreograph and GOAT. With 1,000+ people based across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, WPP Media’s primary purpose is to maximize performance of WPP’s agencies by operating as leader and collaborator in trading, content creation, sports, digital, finance, proprietary tool development and other business-critical capabilities. WPP Media’s focus is to deliver unrivalled advantage to its clients, stakeholders, and people. Combined with WPP Media’s global scale, our media investment decisions—guided by brand safety, leading privacy principles and premium relationships— represent 1 out of 3 ads in the global marketplace. Through modern investment services, we put money against goals that move businesses forward.

Implementation & Activation

The Implementation & Activation team is responsible for delivering best-in-class media planning and buying for our award-winning agency brands. 

The scope of the Implementation & Activation team covers all media channels and touchpoints, with a focus on delivering omnichannel media plans in each of our client patches and brands. Sitting centrally alongside our Implementation & Activation team is our Centre of Excellence, housing the Media Operations team and Craft Heads. 

With our collective industry expertise, we navigate the ever-changing media landscape efficiently and effectively, fuelling growth for the brands we work with. Our commitment to transparency and accountability drives best-in-class results consistently, leveraging our exceptional media relationships to keep our finger on the pulse of emerging opportunities.

Role Outline

The Implementation & Activation Director is a leadership role, overseeing operational excellence and responsible for all day-to-day output that delivers effective campaigns, ensuring best-in-class consistent implementation, optimisation, and reporting. Working very closely with your Head Of and Client Partner, you will produce best-in-class solutions, offer unparalleled service and deliver against targets.

The role involves the application and oversight of specialist technical skills, leadership, and strategic vision. 

Key Responsibilities

CLIENTS
A critical senior point of contact with the client, for Implementation Planning & Activation.
Offer expert perspectives and POVs on recent market trends or developments, ensuring they're shared with key stakeholders regularly.
Regularly meet with vendors and partners to drive your client's agenda, creating opportunities for your team members to get involved and engage.
Focus on building our outstanding client service reputation
Robust understanding of the in-scope services of your clients and the process for completing work above and beyond
Provide innovative strategic insights by acting as an expert on the client's business, industry and competitors.

PRODUCT
Brings innovation and creativity to the table, leveraging market insights.
When required, a strict adherence to activation commitments that have client contract association. 
Lead the construction and presentation of effective and future facing Implementation plans and negotiation strategies that are grounded in strategic priorities and data-led optimisation recommendations. 
Exceptional knowledge of the media landscape, able to confidently articulate and train others on media principles and the how each media touchpoint can fuel growth for clients. 
Identify and lead product innovation opportunities for your clients.
Collaborate closely with internal WPP Media teams to ensure you can clearly articulate the benefits of their inclusion, with a focus on converting growth opportunities that can transform outcomes.
Seek to find, communicate and implement improvements in all aspects of the role.
Responsible for the overall delivery of client campaigns & KPIs, with flawless accuracy.
Support the state and national craft leaders in identifying and implementing tools, technology, data, and automation solutions through the organisation, and then ensuring maximum adoption of best practice.

PEOPLE
Motivate and empower team to achieve individual, team and organisational goals. 
Conduct fortnightly 1:1s, annual Career Conversations and Performance Reviews with direct reports.
Liaise with the People Team to resolve any team disputes to ensure a safe and productive team environment. 
Continuously champion company values to build strong and trusted connections, solution-oriented perspectives and demonstrate genuine care for collective team success.
Foster knowledge sharing, and continuous learning around point of views, trends, and relevant skills to continue nurturing a high-performing team.

GROWTH & MARKETING
Identify, collate and showcase examples of great work from within the team, both internally and externally.
Build the agency’s reputation by contributing to entries for awards and competitions and by contributing to industry thought leadership.
Actively contribute to new business development and pitching as needed.

REQUIRED CAPABILITIES
You feel empowered to bring your authentic self to work, and contribute to great teamwork, knowing your individual ideas and thoughts will be welcome.
Keen interest in our industry and excited to work with market leading partners & technologies.
Inquisitive and demonstrates desire to understand and know more. 
Ability to prioritise tasks effectively, ensuring that the most important and urgent ones are identified and addressed first. 
Results driven with the ability to identify and clearly articulate what’s working and why. 
Problem solving mentality. Attention to detail. Clear communicator.

Job description

Fetch Recruitment is an Australian owned recruitment consultancy, delivering long term benefits to both our candidates and clients within the built environment. At Fetch, we passionate about empowering people to take charge of their careers and realize their potential, regardless of whether this is the candidates we partner with or colleagues in our team. We are looking for a highly driven and polished Business Development Manager committed to building a lasting network of candidates and clients. 


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Due to growth and a high client demand, we have a couple of opportunities for experienced Business Development Managers to join the team. We have opportunities within the engineering and the local government divisions. The role will include, but not limited to, the following responsibilities:
Developing growth strategies and plans
Managing and retaining relationships with existing clients
Increasing client base through canvass calling, use of marketing networking and lead generation
Identifying and mapping business strengths and customer needs
Strive to achieve maximum revenue for Fetch through effective objection handling and negotiation in line with company policy

ABOUT YOU
You may already be a Business Development Manager looking for a new exciting challenge or a hungry Senior Recruitment Consultant with BDM experience looking to prove your abilities.
Demonstrated experience working within the construction, engineering or local government sectors. Previous experience managing a 360 desk and developing new business Leadership qualities is desired but not essential. 
You will be required to have 3+ years experience in business to business sales. It is important you have excellent phone sales skills and experience interacting and building relationships with businesses and corporations.

WHY FETCH?

We are big on celebrating success and have a huge focus on our culture, just to list a few benefits:
Work alongside Industry leaders within Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure and Labour Hire Recruitment
Global PSA Clients
LinkedIn Recruiter License
Highflyers Club
Quarterly Team Building
Networking functions
Yearly team trips away
Access to 6 extra annual leave days
End of month events
Quarterly awards
Microsoft Surface Pro & iPhone
Flexible working from home policy
Modern office in central Southbank location, walking distance from Flinders St Station


We will offer you fast development, support, strong internal and external training and various opportunities. You will benefit from a high salary and a very rewarding commission structure but for that we are looking for the best successful and proven sales professionals.

If you are looking for an opportunity to progress your career within a successful expanding agency, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Please check us out at www.fetchrecruitment.com.au
